'''Viss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Rej Taunt]], an up and coming [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. He went to school with [[Bammy Decree/Legends|Bammy Decree]] but was expelled. Immediately afterward, he took up work as Taunt's bodyguard. He was a very tall, sturdy man.

He accompanied Taunt aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Second Chance'']] to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], where they were to meet with a race named the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]]. They were supposed to be trading [[Eopie/Legends|Eopie]] meat for [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]]. The effort of loading the cargo made Viss stretch his neck out, by doing this he sent the Colicoids into a feeding frenzy. A swarm of the bug-like creatures devoured him.
